sustainability-esg.name: Sustainability & ESG

services.title: ESG strategy & roadmap
services.desc: We find the sustainability issues that matter most to your business and your stakeholders, then turn them into clear targets and a phased plan.
services.rec: a board-ready ESG strategy and a three-year roadmap with owners and milestones.

services.title: Sustainability & ESG reporting (GRI · ISSB)
services.desc: We collect, check and present your ESG data in a report investors and regulators trust.
services.rec: a publication-ready sustainability report in Arabic and English, with a GRI or ISSB content index.

services.title: ESG readiness for listed & pre-IPO companies
services.desc: We measure how ready you are for Saudi Exchange disclosure and close the gaps before investors find them.
inc: gap assessment against Tadawul guidelines and CMA expectations
services.rec: a readiness scorecard and a prioritised plan to close every gap.

services.title: Carbon footprint & GHG inventory (Scope 1–3)
services.desc: We calculate your full emissions profile to the GHG Protocol, so every number can be traced and defended.
services.rec: a GHG inventory report and a calculation workbook ready for third-party verification.

services.title: Net-zero & decarbonisation roadmaps
services.desc: We show exactly how you get from today's emissions to your target, and what each step costs.
inc: reduction targets aligned with recognised methods
services.rec: a costed decarbonisation roadmap, year by year, ready for board approval.

services.title: Supplier ESG readiness
services.desc: We prepare you for the sustainability questionnaires and ratings that large buyers now send with every tender.
inc: policy set (environment, health and safety, ethics)
services.rec: ready-to-use answers and documents that help you qualify and win.

services.title: Green building certification (Mostadam · LEED)
services.desc: We guide your project through the rating system, from the first design workshop to the final certificate.
services.rec: a certified building, with a clear record of every credit achieved.

services.title: Circular economy & waste management (MWAN)
services.desc: We turn waste from a cost into a managed resource and keep you compliant with national regulations.
services.rec: a waste management plan with targets, costs and a compliance checklist.

services.title: Climate risk assessment (ISSB S2)
services.desc: We assess how climate change could affect your assets and business, from extreme heat and water stress to carbon pricing.
services.rec: a climate risk register and an ISSB S2-aligned disclosure.

sustainability-esg.headline: Make sustainability measurable.
sustainability-esg.intro: Investors, regulators and major buyers now ask for ESG data. We help you build it on solid numbers, report it to recognised frameworks and turn it into a plan the board can back.
sustainability-esg.who: Listed and pre-IPO companies, suppliers to Aramco, SABIC, Ma'aden and the giga-projects, and industrial and real estate groups setting net-zero targets.
gets: An action plan with owners and dates
sustainability-esg.cta: Start with the ESG & Carbon Starter.

energy.name: Energy & Decarbonisation

services.title: Energy audits (ASHRAE L1–L3)
services.desc: We measure where every kilowatt-hour goes, from chillers and lighting to compressed air and process loads, and turn it into a ranked list of savings.
services.rec: an audit report and savings register with cost, savings and payback for each measure.

services.title: HVAC, chiller & cooling optimisation
services.desc: Cooling is usually the largest load in a Saudi building. We tune it to use less energy without making anyone less comfortable.
services.rec: an optimisation plan with quick wins and capital measures, and support to put them in place.

services.title: Lighting & motor efficiency
services.desc: Proven, low-risk upgrades that often pay back fastest.
services.rec: an upgrade package with savings, payback and technical specifications ready for tender.

services.title: Rooftop solar & battery storage feasibility
services.desc: We tell you whether solar makes sense on your site, how big it should be and what it returns.
services.rec: a bankable feasibility study you can take to suppliers and finance.

services.title: Energy efficiency compliance (SEEC · SBC 601/602)
services.desc: We check that your buildings and equipment meet Saudi energy codes and standards, and fix what doesn't.
inc: code compliance review for new or existing buildings
services.rec: a compliance report and the documents you need for approvals.

services.title: Energy management systems (ISO 50001)
services.desc: Savings fade without a system to sustain them. We build one that keeps energy performance improving every year.
services.rec: a working ISO 50001 system, a trained energy team and readiness for certification audit.

services.title: Measurement & verification (IPMVP)
services.desc: Independent proof that savings are real, to the protocol banks, energy service companies and auditors recognise.
inc: baseline model adjusted for weather and occupancy
services.rec: verified savings reports you can show your board, your lender or your auditor.

services.title: Energy performance contracting
services.desc: Upgrade now and pay from the savings. On selected projects, our fee is tied to the savings we verify.
services.rec: lower energy bills with little or no upfront capital, and verified results.

energy.headline: Cut the costs. Keep the comfort. Prove the savings.
energy.intro: Energy is one of the largest controllable costs in Saudi buildings and factories, and cooling drives most of it. We find where energy is wasted, rank every fix by payback and verify the savings once they are in place.
energy.who: Factories, commercial and residential buildings, warehouses, hotels, hospitals and universities.
gets: A savings register ranked by payback
A business case for each measure
energy.cta: Start with an Energy Audit & Savings Plan.

technology.name: Energy & Industrial Technology

services.title: Energy & carbon dashboards
services.desc: One screen that shows how much energy each site, building or line uses, what it costs and what it emits.
inc: dashboard build in your chosen platform
services.rec: live dashboards for managers and a monthly summary for leadership.

services.title: IoT energy monitoring & smart metering
services.desc: You can't manage what you can't see. We design the metering that shows where energy goes, in real time.
services.rec: a live, validated feed of energy data from your key systems.

services.title: Building management system (BMS) optimisation
services.desc: Most building systems drift from their original settings over time. We bring yours back into line and make it work harder.
services.rec: lower energy use from equipment you already own, often with little or no capital spend.

services.title: Carbon accounting software selection & setup
services.desc: Spreadsheets break as reporting grows. We help you choose the right platform and set it up properly the first time.
services.rec: a working carbon accounting platform that makes next year's report faster and more reliable.

services.title: AI-based predictive maintenance
services.desc: Catch failing pumps, motors and chillers before they break down or start wasting energy.
inc: alert workflow with your maintenance team
services.rec: early warnings on equipment faults, fewer breakdowns and lower maintenance costs.

services.title: SCADA modernisation advisory
services.desc: Ageing control systems limit efficiency and raise risk. We plan the upgrade so it is safe, phased and secure.
services.rec: a modernisation roadmap and technical specifications ready for tender.

technology.headline: Turn data into decisions.
technology.intro: Most sites already collect energy and equipment data, but few use it. We connect meters, sensors and building systems to dashboards your managers actually use, then apply analytics to catch waste and failures early.
technology.who: Facility managers, plant operators, real estate portfolios and data centres.
gets: One trusted source of energy data

operational-excellence.name: Operational Excellence & Management Systems

services.title: Integrated management systems (ISO 9001 · 14001 · 45001 · 50001)
services.desc: One system instead of four: shared procedures, one audit programme and one management review covering quality, environment, safety and energy.
services.rec: a certification-ready integrated system that costs less to run than separate ones.

services.title: KPI & performance management
services.desc: The right numbers, reviewed at the right level, at the right time.
services.rec: a KPI framework and dashboard that connect daily work to company goals.

services.title: Lean Six Sigma process improvement
services.desc: We remove waste, delays and variation from the processes that matter most, and measure the gain.
services.rec: improvement projects with measured savings in cost, time or quality, and a team trained to keep improving.

services.title: Supply chain & procurement efficiency
services.desc: Lower costs and shorter lead times, from supplier to shelf.
services.rec: a prioritised savings plan with quick wins and longer-term changes.

services.title: Risk management & compliance
services.desc: Know your risks, control them and stay on the right side of Saudi regulations.
services.rec: a living risk and compliance system that your management can review every quarter.

services.title: Change management
services.desc: New systems only work if people use them. We plan the people side of every change.
services.rec: faster adoption, fewer setbacks and changes that last.

operational-excellence.headline: Leaner processes. Certified systems. Clearer results.
operational-excellence.intro: Certifications open doors to tenders and major buyers. Done well, they also make the business run better. We design management systems that pass audit and that your people actually use.
operational-excellence.who: Manufacturers, contractors, suppliers bidding for government, Aramco and SABIC work, and service companies.

government.name: Government & Giga-Project Advisory

services.title: Local content & IKTVA strategy
services.desc: A higher local content score wins contracts. We show you where your score comes from and how to raise it.
services.rec: a practical plan to raise your local content score, with the evidence to back it up.

services.title: Project sustainability management for contractors
services.desc: Giga-project clients set strict sustainability requirements. We help contractors meet them from mobilisation to handover.
services.rec: compliant reporting to your client and fewer surprises on site.

services.title: Energy transition advisory for public entities
services.desc: Public buildings and assets are among the Kingdom's largest energy users. We help entities cut consumption and plan the move to cleaner energy.
services.rec: an energy transition roadmap aligned with national targets, with a clear first phase.

government.headline: Delivering on Vision 2030, project by project.
government.intro: Government entities, giga-projects and their contractors carry the Kingdom's most ambitious targets. We help turn those targets into compliant, measurable delivery on the ground.
government.who: Government entities, semi-government companies, and giga-project contractors and suppliers.
gets: Compliance with client and regulator requirements
Reporting that stands up to audit
government.cta: Talk to our government advisory team.

agriculture.name: Agriculture & Food Security

services.title: Smart irrigation & water efficiency (Drip · Sensors)
services.desc: We design irrigation that delivers the right water, at the right time, to the right root zone.
services.rec: an irrigation upgrade plan with water savings, cost and payback.

services.title: Solar-powered farms (PV pumping)
services.desc: Diesel pumps are costly and polluting. We size solar pumping and farm solar systems that pay for themselves.
services.rec: a bankable feasibility study ready for suppliers and finance.

services.title: Soil & fertiliser management (Fertigation)
services.desc: We match nutrients to what the soil and crop actually need, so less fertiliser goes to waste.
services.rec: a seasonal fertiliser programme with expected savings.

services.title: Precision agriculture & farm monitoring (IoT · Satellite)
services.desc: See every field on one screen and act before problems spread.
inc: farm dashboard for water, energy and yield
services.rec: a live farm dashboard and monthly performance reports.

services.title: Greenhouses & protected agriculture
services.desc: Cooling is a major cost in Saudi greenhouses. We cut it, and we test new growing models before you invest.
services.rec: an optimisation plan for existing sites, or a feasibility study for new ones.

services.title: Farm sustainability & certification (Saudi GAP · GLOBALG.A.P.)
services.desc: Buyers, exporters and investors want proof of good practice. We get you ready.
inc: gap assessment against good agricultural practice standards
services.rec: a certification-ready farm and a sustainability report for buyers and investors.

agriculture.headline: Grow more with less water.
agriculture.intro: Agriculture uses most of the Kingdom's water, and food security is a national priority. We help farms and agribusinesses cut water, fertiliser and energy costs with smart irrigation, solar power and precise nutrient management.
agriculture.who: Commercial farms, greenhouse and hydroponic operators, date palm growers, agribusiness investors and food producers.
gets: A water and energy baseline for your farm
A costed irrigation and solar plan
agriculture.cta: Start with a Farm Water & Energy Assessment.
